text:
jen: Going to toggle feature flag llm_highq_v2 during the v2.3.1 deploy. Ramp plan: 10% -> 40% -> 80% over ~30m. Posting for heads-up + ack. :eyes:
deploy-bot: [deploy] inference-api v2.3.1 started on cluster-us-west. Canary cohorts created.
dave: Ack. I'll watch errors & p99. Have a soft rollback ready.
samantha: Watching traces and qps. Dashboard -> https://dash.redwood/inference/canary
alice: Suggest pin fallback route to model=quantized-v1 for cohort >=90% if errors spike. I can apply.
jen: Yes pinning rule good. Add opsbot automation: if errors > 1% for 3m, pin and mute flag.
opsbot: Rule created: if inference_errors > 1% for 180s then set route.pin=quantized-v1 and set ff llm_highq_v2=off. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary at 10% -> metrics 0.12% errors, p99 +3ms. Proceeding to 40%.
dave: small tail spike at minute 8, 0.9% but recovered in 90s. keeping an eye.
samantha: Traces show retry bursts from client X, not model. Not flag-related yet.
jen: Hold at 40% for 10m to verify latency and cost. Manual holdpoint set.
dave: adding temporary alert: p99 > 250ms for 5m -> page #oncall
deploy-bot: Holdpoint hit. Awaiting manual unpause.
alice: Logs look clean. Recommend continue to 80% after hold if no regression.
jen: Ok moving to 80% in 5m. If opsbot triggers, we rollback and pin routing, then open incident.
deploy-bot: 80% applied. Health: errors 0.14%, p99 130ms, cost delta +8%.
samantha: small spike at minute 4 after 80% but within threshold. Recommend continue to 100% after 20m soak.
jen: copy. I'll draft release notes blurb and update rollback steps: run `deployctl rollback --service inference-api --version v2.3.1` or `opsctl set-flag llm_highq_v2 off`.
dave: ack. tagging @oncall for the next 20m.
jen: thanks everyone :rocket:
